hook.text: Your social media friends list tells platforms more about you than your profile ever could.

buildup.text: The social graph maps every connection: who you know, how you're connected, and how closely.

discovery.text: Your friends' interests, locations, and demographics are used to predict yours — even what you never shared.

twist.text: Researchers can predict your personality, political views, and even your sexuality from your friend list alone.

climax.text: You don't need to share anything. Your friends' data draws a detailed portrait of you.

punchline.text: Tell me your friends. I know who you are.

quiz.question: What can platforms infer from your social graph alone?
options: Personality, political views, and demographics — even if you shared nothing
Only how many friends you have
